open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: issue_service_credential: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make its own reads and writes, wherever its other notes call for them, of the records the ServiceIdentityRepository holds through get_service_principal and insert_service_credential of the service_identity repository of that transaction.
open_points.other_text: issue_service_credential: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build the new credential and the returned = models.ServiceCredentialIssue with the imported build_service_credential_issue, passing the credential_id it generated, the issued secret, the key_version _next_key_version derived, the one utc_now instant of the operation as now, the supplied expires_at after its UTC conversion or None when none was supplied, the addressed principal_id and the authorized administrator context; the plaintext reaches the caller only inside that ServiceCredentialIssue.
open_points.question: Must issue_service_credential perform the key-version repository read itself through a listed repository operation, or must _next_key_version perform that read as the second note requires?
